svg.aria-label: Write Path, Pipesmith Registry 0.2.1. A write is in the store and the index before the answer; a delete marks the blob and removes no file. 1: Client to Server: PUT /repository/<hosted>/<path>. 2: Server: origin, credentials, permission, policy, size, free space. 3: Server to content/tmp: stream the body: MD5, SHA-1, SHA-256, SHA-512. 4: Server: size and digest checked; path lock; index lock within 10 s. 5: content/tmp to content/<minute>: rename the bytes, write <id>.properties. 6: Server to reconciliation: one line: time, <id>, true. 7: Server to index.sqlite: row in files_<store>, same transaction. 8: Server to Client: 201; the file is served at once. Delete. 9: Client to Server: DELETE /repository/<hosted>/<path>. 10: Server to index.sqlite: no row: 404; row in a store of the existing install: 409. 11: Server to content/<minute>: deleted=true, deletedReason, deletedDateTime. 12: Server to index.sqlite: row dropped; no file removed. 13: Server to Client: 204.
svg.title: Pipesmith Registry write path
